# Orion MIS

> Orion MIS is a UK warehouse automation OEM. We design, build and install
> complete automation systems — conveyors, the Helix modular parcel sorter,
> robotics, vision and the Helios warehouse operating system — from one UK
> facility, with pay-monthly finance available on every system.

Key facts:

- Helix is a modular parcel sortation system: it sorts parcels on a 200mm gap,
  scales in 200mm modules up to 20,000 parcels per hour, and handles bags,
  boxes and awkward freight.
- Helios is the warehouse operating system built alongside Orion hardware:
  routing, live dashboards, fault detection and reporting, live on UK sites now.
- Every system can be bought outright or paid for monthly through finance.
- Customers are UK parcel centres, 3PLs and fulfilment operations.
- Contact: info@orionmis.co.uk · book a call at https://orionmis.co.uk/call

## Sectors

- [Parcel centres](https://orionmis.co.uk/parcel-centres): parcel sortation for
  parcel centres and postal operators — Helix sortation, An Post case study
- [3PL automation](https://orionmis.co.uk/3pl-automation): multi-client routing,
  modular expansion and an ROI-led commercial case — Expeditors case studies
- [Fulfilment & e-commerce](https://orionmis.co.uk/fulfilment-automation): SLAM
  lines, pick towers, multipack lines and AMR fleets — Amazon, Gompels, Octopus
- [Food & beverage manufacturing](https://orionmis.co.uk/food-manufacturing):
  food-grade conveyors and end-of-line palletising — Tate & Lyle, Denso

## Insights

- [Cross-belt vs tilt-tray vs wheel sorters](https://orionmis.co.uk/parcel-sorter-comparison):
  how the three parcel sortation technologies work, honest strengths and
  weaknesses, and how to choose on destination count, parcel mix, footprint
  and budget
- [What does warehouse automation cost in the UK?](https://orionmis.co.uk/warehouse-automation-cost-uk):
  2026 cost guide — entry systems from ~£4,000/month financed, a worked
  £320.9k sorter example with 4-month payback, hidden costs and install
  timelines
- [Print & apply labelling systems: a UK buyer's guide](https://orionmis.co.uk/print-and-apply-labelling-guide):
  how print & apply works — print engine, tamp/blow/wipe applicators,
  verification scanning — a buyer's checklist, and the ten Amazon SLAM lines
  as proof
- [The real cost of manual parcel sortation (UK, 2026)](https://orionmis.co.uk/cost-of-manual-sortation):
  the wage-bill maths of a manual sort line at £16.30/hr all-in, the invisible
  costs of agency, overtime and rework, and what the same money buys in
  automation
